notes: Plan the load out. Load in / Load out over the truck switches between two plans for the gig: how the trucks pack going in, and how they pack coming home (things struck in a different order, the rig coming apart its own way, or a truck emptied and refilled). The first Load out asks how to start: from the load in (every case where it went in; move what comes off differently) or empty (To pack lists every case; Pack the rest works as usual). Every truck gets its load-out twin, with the same truck, label and name; naming a truck names its twin too. The load in never changes when you work on the…
